traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Aquifoliaceae with Phellinaceae, Sphenostemonaceae, which APG and WCVP join to it (their extra states read as sometimes): leaves usually alternate, rarely opposite or whorled; leaves simple; margins dentate, entire or serrate; veins pinnate; leaves evergreen; stipules present or absent; plants dioecious or polygamous, sometimes hermaphrodite; ovary superior; floral cup absent; stems woody; flowers in panicles or in cymes, sometimes in racemes, rarely solitary; flowers actinomorphic; perianth sepals and petals, tepals or absent; fruit drupe; parts of each whorl 4 (-8); stamens 4 to 8 (-12); carpels (2-) 4 to 6 (-24). Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.

traits.phyllotaxis_pattern.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 428, 430, 431, family Aquifoliaceae: phyllotaxis pattern spiral (rarely opposite), usually; read as {"spiral": "usually"}.

traits.flowering_position.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 428, 430, 431, family Aquifoliaceae: flowering position lateral; read as "lateral".

traits.leaf_margin.note: Added kinds only; the usual kind's source is the family's `traits` note. The books add spiny (rarely): Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 428, 430, 431: spiny.

traits.leaf_shape.note: Lucid family key, Aquifoliaceae (read 2026-10-17): simple symmetric blades, elliptic, oblong or orbicular. Ilex (over 570 species, Wikipedia (read 2026-10-17)) is the family.

traits.leaf_incision.note: DELTA, Aquifoliaceae (read 2026-10-17): lamina entire or cut, cut ones pinnatifid or spiny (holly type).

traits.leaf_base_shape.note: Lucid family key, Aquifoliaceae (read 2026-10-17): base cuneate or attenuate.

traits.sexual_system.note: Wikipedia Ilex (read 2026-10-17): over 570 species, i.e. nearly all of Aquifoliaceae (Ilex is its only genus in the APG sense); hollies generally dioecious, male and female flowers on separate plants. Polygamous and bisexual flowers kept as minor states from the family's DELTA coding.

traits.perianth.note: Wikipedia Ilex (read 2026-10-17): the small greenish-white flower has four petals; with Ilex making up almost all of the family, a calyx-and-corolla perianth is the norm. The tepals and absent states came from the small genera DELTA merges in (Phellinaceae, Sphenostemonaceae), so they drop to rarely.

traits.inflorescence.note: POWO Aquifoliaceae (read 2026-10-17): the family is now the single genus Ilex (500-600 spp, Nemopanthus sunk), so the genus decides. All four accounts quoted there (Neotropikey, Kew Temperate Families handbook, Flora Zambesiaca, Flora of Tropical East Africa) give axillary cymes or fascicles of cyme origin, sometimes apparently single flowers; none names panicles or racemes, so those drop to rarely.
